narration.text: [whispers] FWD: Si Maria Labo, nakabalik na raw. Ingat kayo. [long pause] [softly] Noong dekada nobenta, kumalat ito sa text. Isang babaeng naging aswang daw, at tinaga ng asawa ang mukha niya. [long pause] Nasa Iloilo raw siya. Hindi, sa Capiz. Hindi, nandito na raw. [long pause] Manikurista raw siya sa palengke. Laging nakatakip ang buhok sa kalahati ng mukha. [long pause] Walang biktimang naitala. Walang petsa. Tsismis lang na pinapasa-pasa. [long pause] Pero gabi-gabi, may nanay na nagsasara ng pinto. [long pause] [whispers] Isang text mula sa hindi kilalang numero. [long pause] [whispers] Nasa labas na ako.
attempts: 2026-11-15: one call, both takes started at once (619 credits each)
narration.processing: split into 8 lines, pauses inside a line capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change; gaps widened for the picture; timeline 48.67 s

prompts.whetstone: A long blade slowly sharpened on a whetstone, steady scraping strokes, close, quiet room at night, no music
prompts.vibrate: An old mobile phone vibrating on a wooden table, buzzing and rattling against the wood, quiet room, no music
prompts.door: A wooden door slammed shut and a heavy wooden bar dropped across it, then glass jalousie slats rattling, night, no music
